results.title: The phone's Theme & text sheet
results.checks: On an iPhone 13 the sliders in the chapter's top bar open the old reader's Theme & text sheet: the larger A makes the verses larger and the smaller A smaller; the line-spacing button cycles the spacing; UI size L, then M; Keep screen awake toggles; Go to all settings opens the Settings list in the drawer
results.note: text m → l → m; spacing normal → relaxed and back; UI size L then M; keep awake toggled; Go to all settings opened Settings

results.title: Footnote links, an embed's marks, the phone's note count
results.checks: John 1:23's footnote 'Isaiah 40:3' is a link that opens Isaiah 40 with verse 3 chosen; a highlight on John 3:3 is not drawn when John 3 is embedded; with a note on John 3:16, a phone shows a note marker in the margin level with verse 16 and the note count in its header; each opens the note
results.note: John 1:23's footnote opened Isaiah 40:3; the embed left out the highlight; the phone's margin marker and header ('1 note for this chapter') each opened it
